text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
! Good morning.
You're up early today as well, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
!
I wanted to settle things with what
didn't go so well yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right! Well then, let's both
give it our best in morning training today!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course.
—Though before that...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There is one favor I'd like to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Me... with Oguri-san...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-san. Is that treadmill over there
available for use?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Y-Yeah, go ahead!
Are you doing cardio?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. I intend to use the machine—
to conduct a simplified speed measurement.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... phew... 2000m marker passed...
Reducing speed, transitioning to cool-down...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, that speed is amazing as expected...!
You've got such an incredible engine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
However, my recorded times have currently hit a plateau.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Maybe you're running out
of gas right at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
After you take a break, let's train together!
I was looking to build up my stamina too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! That was a great sweat!!
Look at this, my muscles are so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Detected significant heat source within muscle fibers.
To push this far... my gratitude for your advice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you too! Having a partner
really lets you push past your limits!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...—Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the muscle training you taught me before,
lately, I have not felt much progression...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! There could be a few reasons for that...
For now, could you show me your form once?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!! What a powerful pump!
Your muscles are getting even more shredded! ...However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Indeed—I see now!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To strengthen the upper body...
I should begin with squats?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To be precise, it benefits both
your upper body and lower body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The legs have a huge mass of muscle, so
working them out stimulates the nerves and system!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Building up your lower body now will directly
translate to a stronger upper body later on!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The more you strengthen your lower body,
the further you'll be able to grow, Duramente-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Today's training effect: tremendous.
Recognized as high-quality training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I give you my thanks, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't mention it!
Watching everyone grow is super fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-chan extended her running distance...
Duramente-chan strengthened her lower body—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you train that hard,
you're bound to win in your races!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No matter who you're up against—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —"No matter who", you say?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Would you grant me some advice as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! Sure, I'd love to... but that's rare, isn't it?
For you to ask someone for advice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I simply utilize what is available. Nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—It goes... without saying,
Gentil's... strong point is her power!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To utilize that strength... a core... is essential!
Planks... side planks...
Strengthening the base will double, triple that power...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—...Phew~! Nice muscle!
Let's move on to the next routine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You still have stamina, right?
Let's do 3 more sets together after a short break!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
While calling it instruction, you join in as well, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Y-Yeah.
Doing it together helps me get a better
feel for what the other person is experiencing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph? Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You are quite shrewd, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Grasping how your opponent feels.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Seeing right through their distinctive traits.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Even discerning precisely how much stamina I had left.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho.
How that will resonate... I shall look forward to seeing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That caught me off guard... "shrewd", she said.
I didn't have any intentions like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hohoho.
How that will resonate... I shall look forward to seeing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san,!
Um, about what you mentioned earlier...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "There is one favor I'd like to ask of you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge for a scratch race!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... truly?
You said before that you needed some time, though—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... sorry for taking so long to reply.
Back then, I just didn't have enough confidence... but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I have my own unique strengths.
And by putting them fully to use—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I want to take you on. Not just with strength alone—
with the absolute "full power" that I possess, against you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the track in the early morning
for training preparations...

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaah!
Yaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Focus on the muscles—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not on the "monster" named Oguri-san.
Focus on Oguri-san's "muscles".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Her full thighs, her supple calf muscles.
...Possessing solid musculature like that means—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She has everything—stamina, speed, all of it!
Which means—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Don't panic... not yet!!
Endure just a little longer—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (On this final stretch, all at once—I'll strike from behind!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Ahhh, no good, huh!
And here I thought an "opening" would appear on the straight.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm, on the straight... did you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Because you have high standards across the board, Oguri-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I thought some "roughness" might show in
your stamina management or the timing of your spurt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But there wasn't anything like that at all...
You really are incredible, Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that was a close match.
Had my judgment faltered for a second, you would have overtaken me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...As I thought, you are strong.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Whenever I arrive at the training grounds,
you are always already running, drenched in sweat.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Determined never to lose to the person you were yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I thought running with someone like you would help me understand.
What it is that I am currently lacking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oguri-san...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This race was great stimulation for me.
—Thank you, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And let's race again.
Next time, on the actual racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I won't lose next time either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the race on the early morning
training track filled me with fired-up motivation as well.
